description: Configure Screaming Frog SEO Spider to extract product UPC codes and review counts from https://books.toscrape.com/ using Regex Custom Extraction. STEPS: 1. Go to Configuration > Custom > Extraction. 2. Add a rule named 'UPC': select 'Regex' mode, use pattern 'UPC([^<]+)', and extract the first group. 3. Add a rule named 'ReviewCount': select 'Regex' mode, use pattern 'Number of reviews(\d+)', and extract the first group. 4. Crawl 'https://books.toscrape.com/'. 5. After the crawl finishes, export the Custom Extraction results (or All results) to a CSV file in '~/Documents/SEO/exports/'. SUCCESS CRITERIA: A CSV file must exist in the exports directory containing crawled URLs and the extracted UPCs (16-char hex strings) and review counts.
